summary: Your fourteenth Sunday review and the end of Module 7. You answer 9 questions with a confidence number, write the module retrospective, set up a weekly routine of two or three job applications with honest claims and a 45-minute routine, rehearse a 60-second demo, extend your glossary, run it from cold, tag week 14 and plan week 15.
goal: M7 retrospective; start 2-3 job applications a week.

items.text: Self-test: answer the 9 questions with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Write the Module 7 retrospective, 2 lines for each of 5 questions
Choose roles, write your honest claims, do one 45-minute application routine and start the log
Rehearse the 60-second demo out loud with a timer
Run it from cold: Python, gateway and page using only your README
Run git tag week-14, then plan week 15 with an outcome sentence, a drop list and 2 or 3 applications
Play the Module 7 Mix-up game to the end and see your score
